core_obligations: The maps are simplicial and compatible (proof lines 6755-6766): f star 1_X has components X_n -> X_n built from f star 1_{X_n}; the centrality identity a circ (f star 1_F) = f star a = (f star 1_G) circ a shows f star 1_X and 1_X star f are morphisms of simplicial objects compatible with f via the augmentation epsilon.
The homotopy family (lines 6767-6774): h_{n,i} = 1_i star f star 1_{n+1-i} with the 1_a shorthand; h_{n,0} = f star 1_{X_n} and h_{n,n+1} = 1_{X_n} star f checks condition (1).
Condition (2) in full (lines 6776-6800): for i > j both sides of the required identity reduce to d^{i-1}_j star f star 1_{n+1-i}, using the d^n_j-interleaving formula and the centrality identity.

Conditions (3), (4), (5) (lines 6802-6816): checked 'in exactly the same manner using the strategy of the proof of Lemma godement-two-maps' (see notes), with the author's footnote reducing the invertible case to godement-two-maps with (a_n) = 1_X, (b_n) = f^{-1} star 1_X star f, a = b = 1.
proof_roadmap: Prove the maps are simplicial and f-compatible via the centrality identity.
Interpolate with h_{n,i} = 1_i star f star 1_{n+1-i} and verify condition (2) explicitly.
Dispatch conditions (3)-(5) by the template calculus and note the invertible-case shortcut.

H2: star-calculus continuation of the Godement toolkit.
